fusions.name: Chigger Peck
fusions.desc: Pecks the target for 4 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Spurs
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and spur it for 13 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Wire Hop
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward in a single hop. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lively Step
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
